summary: UPDATED — status NOT_YET_RECRUITING. Sponsor: Children's Hospital Medical Center, Cincinnati. Conditions: Rheumatic Heart Disease. Interventions: AI assisted echocardiography. Type INTERVENTIONAL, enrollment 62. Start 2026-11, primary completion 2028-06. The main goal of this project is to see if RADAR (Rapid AI-assisted Detection and Analysis of Rheumatic heart disease), which is a machine and deep-learning AI model, can help make rheumatic heart disease (RHD) screening easier to expand. Specifically, the project will test whether RADAR can screen as accurately-or more accurately-than current methods, and whether it can be used effectively in different low-resource settings. The aim is to show that RADAR could be adopted and used widely around the world.
title: Artificial Intelligence to Scale Early Rheumatic Heart Disease Detection (NCT07599956)

triage.summary: Cincinnati Children's trial (n=62, start 2026-11) tests RADAR, an AI-assisted echo model, for rheumatic heart disease screening in low-resource settings. Status updated, not yet recruiting.
triage.why_it_matters: Academic AI echo screening effort with no tracked-company tie; a signal of AI echo expanding into task-shifted screening, not a direct Cleerly issue.
